criteria.notes: Board answers "can I reach that office now": per-office local time, offset from home, working window and open state.
Follows the world-clock reference in structure (parallel columns, one hairline per boundary) without copying its styling.
Warm paper palette, heavy tabular clock and wide-tracked micro-labels; not the default dark dashboard look shared by other examples.
Clock dominates at every tier; small tier sheds zone, hours, transition and date rather than shrinking them under the floor.
Light and dark presets both verified; accent carries the open state against both backgrounds.
Office name is auto-fitted against a two-line budget, so a long name never forms a clipped third line (see scenario-long-labels).
Board wraps into rows once a column would fall under 210px, and wrapped rows carry their own hairline; verified at 600x600 and 768x768.
No raster assets; the whole board is type, rule and colour, so nothing degrades at any surface size.
Only example built as parallel per-entity clocks with a home-relative offset; distinct from the single-hero clock.
